summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its Annual General and Special Meeting held June 16, 2026. All director nominees were elected, Deloitte LLP was appointed auditor, and a non-binding say-on-pay resolution was approved. This filing contains routine shareholder meeting outcomes, no special situation transaction, no deal terms, and no corporate event triggering a special-situations classification. The filing is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer and does not involve any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change that would warrant a special-situation categorization.
